# Denis Tsoi — Forward Deployed Engineer

> Forward Deployed Engineer with 10+ years shipping mobile, web and AI products across banks, fintech and startups. Embeds with customers and turns rough specs into systems that run in production for years. Based in Australia (permanent resident, no visa sponsorship needed); available from Q4 2026.

## Looking for

- **Target role**: Forward Deployed Engineer
- **Also open to**: Solutions / Customer Engineer, Founding Engineer
- **Best fit**: AI and fintech platforms selling into regulated customers
- **Work mode**: Remote or on-site, Australia
- **Languages**: English, Cantonese (limited)
- **Stack**: TypeScript, React Native, GraphQL, Node, Python, Ollama / LM Studio, AWS / GCP

## Why Forward Deployed Engineering

- **Customer-side**: Three years as an account exec and precious metals dealer before engineering. At CoverGo, led the React Native app for a major banking client and built integrations across multiple insurer partners.
- **Production-grade**: At Mox Bank, release champion for the iOS/Android app, on-call owner for the GraphQL gateway, and technical sign-off across 10+ product teams.
- **Applied AI**: As Co-Founder/CTO of preferrd.io, built private, local LLM infrastructure on Ollama and LM Studio, and prototyped AI personas as business support tools.

## Selected deployments

- **Private LLM stack — preferrd.io (2025–26)**: Internal apps needed AI without sending data to third parties. Designed and ran local LLM infrastructure; prototyped AI personas as support tools. Outcome: secure, private model deployments and more efficient internal workflows.
- **Shipping a bank's app — Mox Bank (2020–25)**: A regulated virtual bank releasing iOS/Android across many product teams. Release champion handling cross-team coordination, risk assessment and sign-offs for 10+ teams. Outcome: owned critical releases, cut onboarding crash rates, led GraphQL gateway RCA and observability.
- **Delivery for a banking client — CoverGo (2018–19)**: An insurtech platform delivering to a major bank and multiple insurer partners. Led the client's React Native app; built user flows and API integrations on a multi-tenant Vue/GraphQL platform. Outcome: core features shipped, performance improved, code standards set for the project.

## Experience

- **2026 — Full-time Dad** (career break, Australia): Planned break; relocated to Australia as a permanent resident. Available from Q4 2026.
- **2025–2026 — Co-Founder / CTO, preferrd.io** (AI startup, Hong Kong): Led AI-assisted development; built private LLM infrastructure and AI personas for internal workflows.
- **2020–2025 — Senior → Staff Engineer, Mox Bank** (virtual banking, Hong Kong): Release champion for the iOS/Android app. As Team Lead, ran technical sign-offs across 10+ product teams and mentored engineers. On-call owner for the GraphQL gateway (incidents, RCA, observability). Led React Native for customer onboarding, reducing crash rates.
- **2018–2019 — Software Engineer, CoverGo** (insurtech, Hong Kong): Led a React Native app for a major banking client; built flows and integrations on a multi-tenant insurance platform.
- **2018 — Software Engineer, Scribe Intelligence** (AI / speech, Hong Kong): AI-powered audio transcription on Node/Python, AWS/GCP; open-source AI contributions (Gentle).
- **2016–2018 — Software Engineer, EnergyBox** (IoT / energy, Hong Kong): On-premise IoT energy monitoring and compliance; end-to-end QA for site reliability.
- **2013–2016 — Developer, Seed Alpha, Makible, Imagination** (fintech, e-commerce, digital agency, Hong Kong): Financial research app and chatbot for institutional investors; e-commerce; a touch-table interface for Pacific Place.
- **2010–2013 — Account Exec → Senior Dealer, Acetop, Chancellor** (precious metals, Hong Kong): Client-facing sales and precious metals OTC dealing before moving into engineering.

## Community

Explaining technology so people can use it is half of forward-deployed work — done outside the day job for over a decade: teaching refugees in Hong Kong, organising the city's developer meetups, and speaking at them.

### Teaching

- **Te(a)ch at the Grassroots — Grassroots Future / Operation Santa Claus (2025)**: Designed and taught a 10-week programming course for refugee kids in Hong Kong: a class of 12 across two age groups (under 11 and 11–16). Sourced, funded and customised the hardware, and built the project work around cardboard robotics. Volunteering with Grassroots Future since 2020.
- **Teaching code to refugees — Refugeek, BSD Academy (2018)**: Taught web development to refugees in Hong Kong through BSD Academy's follow-on programme that prepares students for the job market wherever they're resettling next.

### Organising (2014–2024)

- **2019–2024 — Core Organiser, Hong Kong Golang Meetup Group**: Core organiser of Hong Kong's Go community for 4+ years.
- **2017–2018 — Organiser, Think HK (UX design meetup)**: Curated speakers and grew an invite-only mailing list to 100+ subscribers.
- **2014–2018 — Co-Organiser, Hong Kong Web Developers (HKWD)**: Co-organised one of Hong Kong's web developer communities for 4+ years.

### Speaking (11 talks & workshops, 2013–2017)

Speaker at Hong Kong Web Developers (HKWD), Code Conf HK, Women Who Code HK and FinHack. [All slides](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/)

- 2017 — [From Junior to Senior Developer: Lone Wolf to Wolf Pack](https://hongkong.codeconf.io/2017/) (talk, Hong Kong Code Conf, 22 Oct 2017): what makes a successful senior developer, frameworks to self-evaluate career progression, and forming "packs" that shape company culture and build sustainable support networks.
- 2017 — [UI/UX: Mobile First](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2017-ux-finhack/) (talk, FinHack): from skeuomorphism to flat design, principles for good mobile and desktop UX, and when to break the rules, for hackathon teams in fintech, insurance and regtech.
- 2017 — [Docker Workshop](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2017-devops/) (workshop): hands-on from hello-world to networked containers, Docker Compose, and scaling a service across a Docker Swarm.
- 2017 — [Git Workshop](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2017-git/) (workshop, EnergyBox): Git from the terminal for the team: init, clone, commit, amend, reset, remotes and tagging releases.
- 2016 — [Easy as Pi](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2016-easy-as-pi/) (ongoing project): DevOps 101 on a Raspberry Pi cluster: building the rig, ARM distros like Hypriot, and untangling Docker, Kubernetes and orchestration jargon.
- 2016 — [Laravel Setup](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2016-laravel/) (talk): setting up PHP, Composer and Laravel on macOS, from a front-end and Node developer's point of view.
- 2016 — [Maps](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2016-maps/) (talk): reviewing web mapping tools (Cesium, Mapbox, Deck.gl, D3, Three.js and more) and choosing a renderer that conveys meaning without overloading the viewer.
- 2014 — [JS 102](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2014-js102/) (talk): for junior developers: objects, constructors and the prototype pattern, building up to a small jQuery-style library.
- 2014 — [Sass](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2014-sass) (talk, Women Who Code HK): Sass as CSS on steroids: nesting, variables, mixins, extends and partials, part of a front-end series.
- 2013 — [WTF CSS3D](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2013-wtf-css/) (talk, HKWD): CSS 3D transforms with live CodePen demos, why to favour CSS classes over jQuery animation, and where CSS 3D stops scaling.
- 2013 — [WTF Three.js](https://denistsoi.github.io/talks/2013-threejs/) (talk, HKWD): an intro to WebGL and Three.js: the graphics pipeline, cameras, lights, meshes and materials, then live code.
